function echo<T>(input: T | {value:T; kind:'a'}): T | { value:T; kind:'a' } { return input; }
function echoO<T>(input: T | {value?:T; kind:'a'}): T | { value?:T; kind:'a' } { return input; }
const elem:{value:number; kind?:'a'; extra:boolean}={value:1,extra:true};
console.log(echo(elem),echoO(elem));
function record<T>(input:{first:T; next?:T}):T[] { return []; }
const recordValues:number[]=record({first: 1, next:undefined});
function list<T>(input: T | [T,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function ro<T>(input: T | readonly [T,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function direct<T>(input: [T,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function withRest<T>(input: [T,T?,...T[]]): T[] { return []; }
const input:[number,undefined]=[1,undefined];
const mutable:number[]=list(input);
const readonly:number[]=ro(input);
const fixed:number[]=direct(input);
const rest:number[]=withRest([1,undefined,2]);
const firstMayBeUndefined:[number|undefined,number]=[undefined,1];
const required:(number|undefined)[]=list(firstMayBeUndefined);
console.log(recordValues,mutable,readonly,fixed,rest,required);
